core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace, Sheerness, Guide Price £150,000
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness, for sale by Modern Method of Auction with no onward chain. The property requires modernisation throughout and offers a rear yard.

On the ground floor there is a reception room and a kitchen. The first floor has two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available without the need for a permit.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness.

For sale by Modern Method of Auction. Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. The buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. No onward chain.
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, with a rear yard and no onward chain. Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. EPC E.
